flight_director.name: Flight Director
flight_director.scope: Primary mission contact; coordinates controller reports and applies flight rules.

propulsion.name: Propulsion Controller
propulsion.scope: Propulsion observations; available flow measurements do not prove a root cause.

guidance.name: Guidance Controller
guidance.scope: Guidance workload observations; a normalised index is not a failure probability.

recovery.name: Recovery Coordinator
recovery.scope: Return and retrieval reporting; do not assume safe recovery before a report.

observations.label: What observations and data do we have?

causes.label: What could explain this, and what is uncertain?

seriousness.label: How serious is the reported situation?

recommendation.label: What do you recommend, including abort?

causes: The available observations cannot uniquely distinguish hardware behaviour, instrumentation error and integration effects. A favourable reading or outcome does not establish a root cause. No private physical condition or unreported telemetry is available to this briefing.
triggers: A reported operating-margin concern, new instrument evidence or a flight-rule condition would be assessed by the responsible controller and Flight Director. The crew may initiate an emergency abort independently. This prototype has no detailed subhour flight-rule telemetry or numeric abort-rule display. Executive action requires an explicit escalation within agency authority, not an invented manoeuvre decision.
pause: This pause is for reading and accessibility. It creates no in-world opportunity to delay a flight-rule response. Controller/crew actions already in the record remain in effect; resuming continues the same mission.

launch_sequence.title: Terminal countdown
launch_sequence.text: Terminal count. The authorised configuration and readiness record are on the console; Launch Control proceeds with the approved sequence.

launch_sequence.title: Ignition sequence
launch_sequence.text: Ignition. Launch Control follows the vehicle through the programmed start sequence.

launch_sequence.title: Liftoff
launch_sequence.text: Liftoff. The programme leaves the pad. Flight Control and the crew retain flight-rule and emergency authority.

launch_sequence.title: Early ascent
launch_sequence.text: Early ascent. Controllers follow the departure and prepare handover. The next priorities are spacecraft checkout and the existing engineering questions.
